populatedCapacity.note: capacity with N sole-led groups and N sole-hosted events in the envelope (examples of how the maps reduce it, not bounds); computed from the format, never sent

capacity.note: the most reasons whose body fits maxRequestBytes, computed exactly from the format; a body of that size is not sent (it would take that many reasons)

bodies.perReasonNote: not applicable: no reasons, so no reasonReview and no per-reason size
not applicable: no reasons, so no reasonReview and no per-reason size

overCap.note: a syntactically valid set-v1 body one reason over the capacity, with a synthetic digest: refused (413) before any row is read

legacyComparison.note: the OLD items envelope, measured as a comparison only: synthetic entries of the stated id width. The pilots found 52,760 entries within maxRequestBytes and 52,761 not (413); the old form has a limit that is a function of the entry count; the set-v1 capacity is reported under request.capacity and request.populatedCapacity

request.source: bodies are built from the ids and hashes the server issued for the discovery cases of this size; the sent body is the largest of them, in the panel envelope with a minted 80-hex attempt id
request.refusals: the real largest body with only the last choice code replaced by 3 (400), with the count one higher (400), and with one digest digit changed (409 reason_review_changed, the streamed read and compare, rolled back); each leaves the account as it was
